builds.name: Beginner Starter Build
notes: Only uses basic perks available to all Survivors in the bloodweb.

Kindred (and possibly We'll Make It) give useful info and healing speed when unhooking others. If you see your team mates safely going for the unhook, then you can stay on gens instead and repair some of them faster with Déjà Vu.

Premonition and Dark Sense help you keep an eye on the Killer and will also reveal points of safety occasionally. If you're targeted often after being unhooked, you can run the perk Will to Live (also called Decisive Strike) to have some protection while you're most vulnerable.
The perk "Down to the Last" (also known as Sole Survivor) can also be a good replacement if you find yourself as the final Survivor and want to improve your chances to escape by opening the hatch.

builds.name: Beginner Solo Build
notes: This is a simple and beginner-friendly build that only uses teachable perks from one character, Feng Min. You can further improve this build with the more advanced perks listed as alternatives.

Unlocking Kwon Tae-Young for his perk "Five Moves Ahead" can be a good idea. This perk can replace Dark Sense and improve the overall stregth of this build. Using "Alert" from Feng Min is also a good idea, since it can warn you every time a pallet has been broken by the Killer, helping you keep track of what resources are still available.

"Will to Live" is great if you're being tunneled after you're unhooked, so practice hitting that skill check which will allow you to break free! If you're running Lithe, you can use it on a nearby window or dropped pallet immediately after escaping the Killer's grasp to have a much better chance at a good chase.
This build is overall very flexible but it doesn't give you any option to self-heal. Bringing a med-kit with it is recommended.

The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 16/18/20 seconds.

Last Survivor Standing:  Does not trigger the effect.

perks.desc:

alts.desc:
After you are unhooked by any means, Resurgence triggers the following effect:
Grants you 50/60/70 % of Healing progression.

perks.name: Five Moves Ahead
perks.desc:
This perk activates while you are being chased by the Killer or are inside the Killer's Terror Radius:
After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50 % earlier.
See the auras of the 5 closest Pallets.
This perk goes on a 40/35/30 seconds cool-down when you drop a Pallet while this perk is activated.

alts.name: Unbreakable
alts.desc:
Whenever you are put in the Dying State by the Killer, Unbreakable activates:
Increases your Recovery speed by 25/30/35 %.
Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State.
This ability can only be used once per Trial.

alts.name: Inner Strength
alts.desc:
After cleansing a Totem of any kind, Inner Strength activates.
While active, hiding inside a Locker for 10/9/8 seconds triggers the following effect:
Heals you to the next Health State.
Inner Strength deactivates after use.
Inner Strength cannot be used while suffering from the Broken Status Effect.

notes: Go inside a locker slowly and then come out quickly! Thanks to "Quick & Quiet" you won't make any noise. Doing this will activate "Lucky Star" and "Rapid Response" showing you the auras of your team mates, the Killer and the nearest generator!

Your fourth perk, Inner Strength, can also turn lockers into healing stations if you've cleansed a totem. There's many other great alternatives depending on your playstyle and the item you're bringing.

perks.desc:
While hiding inside a Locker, you benefit from the following effect:
Suppresses your Grunts of Pain.
After exiting the Locker you benefit from the following effects for 30 seconds:
Suppresses your Grunts of Pain and the creation of Pools of Blood.
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed to you.
The Aura of the nearest Generator is revealed to you and highlighted in yellow.
Lucky Star has a cool-down of 35/30/25 seconds.

Rapid Response cannot be used to override an existing Exhausted Status Effect.

alts.name: Head On
alts.desc:
After hiding in a Locker for 3 seconds, Head On activates.
While active, hold the Sprint button while exiting the Locker to trigger its effect:
Causes you to forcefully launch yourself from the Locker, stunning the Killer if they are too close to it:
Has a Stun range of 2.5 metres.
Has a Stun duration of 3 seconds.
Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for the Killer upon missing.
Head On cannot be used while Exhausted.

alts.desc:
While hiding inside a Locker with a depleted Item equipped, Built to Last triggers the following effect after 12/10/8 seconds:
Recharges the Item to one of the following percentages:
First time: 99 %.
Second time: 66 %.
Third time: 33 %.
Built to Last is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after triggering its effect for the third time.

builds.name: Disappear & Heal Build
notes: After being damaged, you'll start leaving no scratchmarks/blood thanks to Lucky Break and create tons of distance with Overcome.

Use this opportunity to break line of sight and follow an unpredictable path. The Killer is likely to lose you, especially around large buildings or indoor maps! Be careful with Killers that can reveal you with Killer Instinct or other methods.
If you've opened a chest already, you'll start healing passively thanks to Moment of Glory. If not, you can get healed by a team mate or find a chest to start the process.
If you don't use Moment of Glory, be sure to bring a med-kit or some perk to help you get healed fast so that you keep Lucky Break's effects for longer.

perks.desc:
Whenever you are in the Injured State, Lucky Break activates:
Suppresses the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks for up to 40/50/60 seconds.
Whenever you are healing another Survivor, Lucky Break recharges by the same amount of time spent performing the Healing action, up to its initial maximum.
Lucky Break deactivates once its timer runs out or whenever your Health State updates to any other but the Injured State.

perks.name: Overcome
perks.desc:
Whenever you enter the Injured State from full health, Overcome triggers its effect:
Extends the duration of the On-hit Sprint boost by +2 seconds.
Overcome cannot be used while Exhausted.
Overcome causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

alts.name: Iron Will
alts.desc:
While injured, you benefit from the following effects:
Reduces the volume of Grunts of Pain by 80/90/100 %.
Iron Will cannot be used while Exhausted, but does not cause the Status Effect.

perks.name: Moment of Glory
perks.desc:
After performing the Unlocking or Rummaging action on Chests a total of 1 time, Moment of Glory activates:
When you become injured, you instantly suffer from the Broken Status Effect.
You are automatically healed 1 Health State after 80/70/60 seconds.
This effect is cancelled prematurely if you enter the Dying State.
Moment of Glory does not activate if you already suffer from the Broken Status Effect.
Moment of Glory deactivates after healing you.

Grants you 50/60/70 % of Healing progression.

The Auras of the following objects are revealed to you:
Closed Chests located in the environment.
Items sitting inside opened Chests.
Items dropped in the environment.
Increases the chances of finding rarer Items inside Chests by +50 %.
Increases the unlocking speed of Chests by 150/175/200 %.

Nearby Crows no longer fly off and alert others to your presence, unless you come within touching distance.

Chests
Totems

builds.name: Anti-Tunnel Stun Build
notes: Being tunneled? Go down (or use Plot Twist) under a pallet! After stunning the Killer with Will to Live (also known as Decisive Strike), you can immediately drop the pallet and trigger the effects of Smash Hit to make distance (even if the Killer doesn't visually get stunned).
The combination of Five Moves Ahead and Smash Hit is also very solid in general, allowing you to reliably find pallets and create tons of distance if you manage to stun the Killer with one.

Suppresses your Grunts of Pain and the creation of Scratch Marks and Pools of Blood for 5/6/7 seconds.

notes: Quickly do a chest when you're injured to trigger a slow self-heal from Moment of Glory! If you're confident, you can even do it ahead of time.

Doing a single chest will activate Apocalyptic Ingenuity, which lets you rebuild a "fragile" pallet that shatters on use. Most importantly, it reveals the auras of used pallets which is a really nice effect.

Opening Exit Gates.
Repairing Generators.
Sabotaging Hooks.
Searching Chests.

builds.name: All Purpose Team Build
notes: Versatile build allows you to bounce back from any situation.

Tunneled? Use Lithe on a vault after escaping with Will to Live (Decisive Strike). Not tunneled? Heal in seconds with Resurgence. You can also replace Lithe with any other exhaustion perk of your choice.

You can heal yourself with Plot Twist if nobody can help you. If you think the Killer is about to down you, you can use it aggressively in their face to force a difficult decision; leave you there and allow you to fully heal or commit to picking you up (relieving some pressure away from your team mates in doing so). If they pick you up, you can escape their grasp with Will to Live/Decisive if it's available.

Grants a second instance of the primary Haste Status Effect.

alts.desc:

Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State.
Inflicts the Broken Status Effect.
Causes you to automatically re-enter the Dying State after 20/25/30 seconds.

builds.name: Tunnel-prevention Build
notes: This builds helps you keep someone alive if they're being targeted repeatedly by the Killer.

Shoulder the Burden can "steal" a hook stage from them. You also have your own anti-tunnel if the Killer switches onto you. Keep in mind that activating Shoulder will result in you becoming injured for a long time. You might want to bring a med-kit to be ready to heal afterwards.

notes: Your 1st and 2nd perks allow you to pick up a team mate from the ground very quickly, granting one or both of you the Endurance status effect that will protect you for a while.

Try coordinating with your team mates so that a chase ends with a Survivor under a pallet so that you can attempt a pallet rescue. If the Killer hesitates to pick up, that will give them time to recover and possibly allow you to step in for a quick heal that will trigger MFT and WGLF!
Your 3rd and 4th perk allow you to pick yourself up from the ground and also tank a hit without going down!

alts.desc:
After having completed a Healing action on another Survivor, whenever you are in the Dying State, Conviction activates.
While active, press the Active Ability button after reaching at least 25 % Recovery progress to trigger the following effects:
Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State.
Inflicts the Broken Status Effect.
Causes you to automatically re-enter the Dying State after 20/25/30 seconds.

perks.name: Soul Guard
perks.desc:
Whenever you heal or recover from the Dying State, Soul Guard triggers its primary effect:
Grants the Endurance Status Effect for 4/6/8 seconds.
Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action of any kind.
This ability has a cool-down of 30 seconds.
While suffering from the Cursed Status Effect, Soul Guard applies its secondary effect:
Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State..

alts.name: Breakdown
alts.desc:
After you are unhooked by any means, Breakdown triggers its effects:
Instantly breaks that Hook.
Increases its Auto-Repair timer to 180 seconds.
The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 4/5/6 seconds.

alts.name: Bond
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed to you within 20/28/36 metres.

alts.name: Empathy
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of injured or dying Survivors are revealed to you within 64/96/128 metres.

builds.name: Gen-Jockey Build
notes: Best used with a strong toolbox to quickly repair the gens highlighted by Déjà Vu and forcing the Killer to defend gens that are really far apart.
When your toolbox is depleted, you can turn it into a medkit by hopping into a locker with the perk Change of Plan! You can ask a team mate to drop their toolbox and do it once again with theirs too.
Alternatively, you can use Built to Last to refill your empty toolbox and use it multiple times or one of the other suggested perks!

perks.name: Déjà Vu
perks.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of whichever 3 Generators are currently in closest proximity to one another are revealed to you.
Increases your Repair speed on those Generators by 4/5/6 %.

perks.name: Poised
perks.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, Poised triggers its primary effect:
Suppresses the creation of your Scratch Marks for 20/25/30 seconds.
Whenever you start repairing a Generator for the first time, Poised triggers its secondary effect:
The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 8 seconds.

alts.name: Overcome
alts.desc:
Whenever you enter the Injured State from full health, Overcome triggers its effect:
Extends the duration of the On-hit Sprint boost by +2 seconds.
Overcome cannot be used while Exhausted.
Overcome causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

perks.name: Prove Thyself
perks.desc:
Increases the Repair speed by a stack-able 6/8/10 % per other Survivor within 4 metres of your location, up to a maximum of 18/24/30 %.
Prove Thyself extends its effect to all Survivors within its range.
Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Prove Thyself at a time.

alts.name: Bond
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed to you within 20/28/36 metres.

alts.name: Friendly Competition
alts.desc:
Each time you complete a Generator together with at least one other Survivor, Friendly Competition activates:
Increases the Repair speed of all participating Survivors, including yourself, by +10 % for 80/85/90 seconds.

alts.name: Sprint Burst
alts.desc:
Starting to run triggers Sprint Burst:
Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 2 seconds.
Sprint Burst cannot be used while Exhausted.
Sprint Burst causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

perks.name: Change of Plan
perks.desc:
You start the Trial with 2 Tokens.
While hiding inside a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, press Active Ability button to spend 1 Token and transform your Toolbox into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with a random add-on of the same rarity.
The new Med-kit has 80/90/100 % of its charges.

alts.name: Built to Last
alts.desc:
While hiding inside a Locker with a depleted Item equipped, Built to Last triggers the following effect after 12/10/8 seconds:
Recharges the Item to one of the following percentages:
First time: 99 %.
Second time: 66 %.
Third time: 33 %.
Built to Last is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after triggering its effect for the third time.

alts.name: Road Life
alts.desc:
While injured and repairing a Generator, regular Skill Checks have the following effects:
Gain +1 Token for Great Repair Skill Checks.
Gain 0 Tokens for Good Repair Skill Checks.
Lose -1 Token for Failed Repair Skill Checks.
Once you accumulate 6/5/4 Tokens, consume all Tokens to benefit from the following effect:
Unlocks the ability to heal yourself
Increases your Self-Healing speed by +10 % until you stop healing and for 4 seconds after.

alts.name: Adrenaline
alts.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, Adrenaline activates and triggers the following effects:
Heals you to the next Health State.
Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 4 seconds.
Adrenaline can be used while Exhausted and ignores an existing Status Effect.
Adrenaline causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds after use.

builds.name: Team Healer Build
notes: A perfect build to become the "designated healer" of the group. It can save a lot of time over the course of a match if your team is coordinated enough!
With Solidarity, healing others while injured will also heal you passively! After bringing a team mate to full health, they'll be able to finish off your healing in just a matter of seconds.

Empathic Connection is perfect for this build since it reveals your aura to your injured team mates while also boosting healing speed. If you're not in voice comms, you might prefer a perk such as Empathy that allows you to actively seek out team mates yourself.

Your final perk, "A Place For Us", gives you a nice and consistent stealth while healing others. You can swap it for something more aggressive such as "Made For This" if you want to go for riskier heals!

perks.name: Solidarity
perks.desc:
While injured, healing another Survivor causes Solidarity to apply the following effects:
Grants the ability to passively heal yourself while healing other Survivors.
Reduces your Personal Healing speed to 65/70/75 % of your Altruistic Healing speed.

alts.name: Clean Break
alts.desc:
After completing a Healing action on another Survivor, Clean Break activates.
Press the Active Ability button while being healed by another Survivor to trigger the following effects:
Suffer from the Broken Status Effect.
You are automatically healed 1 Health State after 75/60/45 seconds.
This effect is cancelled prematurely if you enter the Dying State.
Clean Break does not activate if you already suffer from Broken.
Clean Break deactivates after healing you.

perks.name: Better than New
perks.desc:
Completing a Healing action on another Survivor grants them the following benefits until they receive damage again:
Increases their Action speeds for Blessing, Cleansing, Healing, and Unlocking by 40/45/50 %.

alts.name: Botany Knowledge
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Healing speed by 30/40/50 %.

alts.name: Do No Harm
alts.desc:
When healing another Survivor, depending on their accumulated Hook Stages, you benefit from the following effects:
Increases your Altruistic Healing speed by 30/35/40 % per Hook Stage, up to a maximum of 60/70/80 %.
Increases the Progression bonus of Great Healing Skill Checks by +3 % per Hook Stage, up to a maximum of +6 %.
Increases the odds of triggering a Skill Check by +5 % per Hook Stage, up to a maximum of +5 %Max.

perks.name: Empathic Connection
perks.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent primary effect:
Increases your Altruistic Healing speed by 30/35/40 %.
Whenever any other Survivor is injured, Empathic Connection applies its secondary effect:
Your Aura as a potential Healer is revealed to them.

alts.name: Empathy
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of injured or dying Survivors are revealed to you within 64/96/128 metres.

alts.name: Boon: Circle of Healing
alts.desc:
A Boon that offers comfort amidst the terror.
Press and hold the Active Ability button on a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem.
All Survivors within 24 metres hear soft chimes ringing out and benefit from its Boon Effects:
Increases the Altruistic Healing speeds by 50/75/100 % when not using a Med-Kit.
If a Survivor is injured, their Aura is revealed to all other Survivors.
Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Boon: Circle of Healing at a time.
Only one Totem can be blessed by your Boon Perks at a time and all of their effects are active on the same Boon Totem.

alts.name: Bond
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed to you within 20/28/36 metres.

alts.name: Aftercare
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
You see the Auras of the 1/2/3  most recent Survivor(s) that helped you or vice versa:
Rescued from a Hook.
Completed a Healing action on.
They also see your Aura.
Aftercare resets its effects when you are hooked by the Killer.

perks.name: A Place For Us
perks.desc:
While healing an another Survivor, both you and the healed Survivor gain Elusive Status Effect.
When you finish healing the Obsession, both you and the Obsession gain Elusive Status Effect for 20/25/30 seconds.
Reduces your chance of becoming the initial  Obsession by reducing the default value by -100 %.
The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

alts.name: Made for This
alts.desc:
Whenever you are in the Injured State, Made for This activates.
While active, completing a Healing action on another Survivor triggers the following primary effect:
Grants the Endurance Status Effect for 6/8/10 seconds.
Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action of any kind.
While active and suffering from the Deep Wound Status Effect, running triggers the following secondary effect:
Grants a 1/2/3 % Haste Status Effect.

builds.name: Boon Support Build
notes: Creates a strong healing area where team mates can be quickly healed and self-pick up.

Use a map with the Sharpened Flint add-on can replace Extrasensory Perception to find totems. If you trust your team's ability to find totems without any tools, feel free to use something else instead!
Your final perk can be whatever you want! An exhaustion perk to quickly help you relocate can be a solid choice.
Good choice for a player that wants to stay in the background.

perks.name: Boon: Circle of Healing
perks.desc:
A Boon that offers comfort amidst the terror.
Press and hold the Active Ability button on a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem.
All Survivors within 24 metres hear soft chimes ringing out and benefit from its Boon Effects:
Increases the Altruistic Healing speeds by 50/75/100 % when not using a Med-Kit.
If a Survivor is injured, their Aura is revealed to all other Survivors.
Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Boon: Circle of Healing at a time.
Only one Totem can be blessed by your Boon Perks at a time and all of their effects are active on the same Boon Totem.

perks.name: Boon: Exponential
perks.desc:
Press and hold the Active Ability button on a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem.
All Survivors within 24 metres hear soft chimes ringing out and benefit from its Boon Effects:
Increases the Recovery speed while in the Dying State by 90/95/100 %.
Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing them to fully recover from the Dying State.
Only one Totem can be blessed by your Boon Perks at a time and all of their effects are active on the same Boon Totem.

alts.name: Boon: Shadow Step
alts.desc:
A Boon that conceals the truth.
Press and hold the Active Ability button on a Dull or Hex Totem to bless it and create a Boon Totem.
All Survivors within 24 metres hear soft chimes ringing out and benefit from its Boon Effects:
Scratch Marks are suppressed.
Auras are hidden from The Killer.
Both effects linger for 2/3/4 seconds after leaving the Boon Totem's range.
Only one Totem can be blessed by your Boon Perks at a time and all of their effects are active on the same Boon Totem.

perks.name: Extrasensory Perception
perks.desc:
Crouch for 4 seconds to activate this perk. While active:
You see the Auras of Survivors, the Killer, and a variety of objects. These are revealed in an expanding 44 meter radius..
Revealed objects include Chests, Exit Gate, Generators, Hatch, Items, Pallets, Totems, and Windows.
You gain Elusive and Oblivious Status Effects
When you stop crouching, or after 11 seconds, all effects of this perk end and it enters a 60/50/40 seconds cool-down.

alts.name: Small Game
alts.desc: You see auras of Totems within 10/11/12 metres.

alts.name: Lend a Hand
alts.desc:
Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates this perk:
Once per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2/3/4  permanent healing charges.

alts.name: Overzealous
alts.desc:
Fighting back against the Ravage motivates and inspires you.
After cleansing or blessing a Totem, Overzealous activates:
Dull Totem: Increases your Repair speed by 8/9/10 %.
Hex Totem: Increases your Repair speed by 16/18/20 %.
Overzealous deactivates after losing a Health State by any means.

perks.name: Sprint Burst
perks.desc:
Starting to run triggers Sprint Burst:
Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 2 seconds.
Sprint Burst cannot be used while Exhausted.
Sprint Burst causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

alts.name: Overcome
alts.desc:
Whenever you enter the Injured State from full health, Overcome triggers its effect:
Extends the duration of the On-hit Sprint boost by +2 seconds.
Overcome cannot be used while Exhausted.
Overcome causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

alts.name: Balanced Landing
alts.desc:
While falling from height, you benefit from the following effects:
Suppresses all noises related to falling and landing.
Reduces the duration of the Stagger upon landing by -75 %.
Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds.
Balanced Landing cannot be used while Exhausted.
Balanced Landing causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds after use.

alts.name: Will to Live
alts.desc:
Using whatever is at hand, you stab your aggressor in an ultimate attempt to escape.
After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Will to Live activates for the next 40/50/60 seconds:
When grabbed or picked up by the Killer, succeed a Skill Check to stab the Killer and escape from their grasp.
Stuns the Killer for 4 seconds.
Causes you to become the next Obsession.
Will to Live is deactivated once the Exit Gates are powered.
Will to Live is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after use.
Will to Live is deactivated prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action.
Increases your chance of becoming the initial  Obsession by increasing the default value by +100 %.
The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

builds.name: Fast Unhook Build
notes: This build makes it nearly impossible for most Killers to secure a kill in the endgame. Perfect for confident teams that trust in their ability to survive until the endgame.

If you're hooked yourself, Slippery Meat or Leader will make your unhooking speed very fast, increasing the odds that everyone will reach the exit gate safely. If someone else is hooked, No One Left Behind help you unhook them very quickly! It will also show you everyone's auras during the to help you stay coordinated.

But what if the Killer interrupts you during the unhook and someone else has to take over? In that case, Overcome (or Hope) will help you create tons of distance and safely reach the exit gate as well.
Your 4th perk can be whatever you want, possibly something to help you reach the endgame safely!

perks.name: Slippery Meat
perks.desc:
You have developed an efficient way to get off Hooks.
Other Survivors unhook you 90/95/100 % faster.
Increases the Haste granted by Unhook Protections by +5 %.

alts.name: Leader
alts.desc:
All other Survivors within 10 metres of your location benefit from the following effect:
Increases their Action speeds for Cleansing, Gate-Opening, Healing, Sabotaging, Unhooking, and Unlocking by 20/25/30 %.
This effect lingers for 15 seconds after leaving its Area of Effect.
Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Leader at a time.

perks.name: No One Left Behind
perks.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, No One Left Behind activates:
The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed to you.
Increases your Action speeds for Healing and Unhooking by 80/90/100 %.
Increases the strength and duration of the Haste Status Effect granted to Survivors you unhook by +10 % and +5 seconds respectively:
Causes them to benefit from a 20 % Haste Status Effect for 15 seconds.

alts.name: Flow State
alts.desc:
Whenever a Generator is completed, gain a token, up to 5.
For each token:
Bless and cleanse Totems 13/14/15 % faster.
Heal 13/14/15 % faster.
Unhook Survivors 13/14/15 % faster.

alts.name: Desperate Measures
alts.desc:
Whenever any Survivor, including yourself, is not in the Healthy State, Desperate Measures activates:
Increases your Action speeds for Healing and Unhooking by a stack-able 16/18/20 % per injured, dying, or hooked Survivor, up to a maximum of 64/72/80 %.

perks.name: Overcome
perks.desc:
Whenever you enter the Injured State from full health, Overcome triggers its effect:
Extends the duration of the On-hit Sprint boost by +2 seconds.
Overcome cannot be used while Exhausted.
Overcome causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60/50/40 seconds.

alts.name: Sole Survivor
alts.desc: Identical to Down to the Last.

alts.name: Hope
alts.desc:
Once the Exit Gates are powered, Hope activates for the remainder of the Trial:
Grants a 3/4/5 % Haste Status Effect.

perks.desc:
Using whatever is at hand, you stab your aggressor in an ultimate attempt to escape.
After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Will to Live activates for the next 40/50/60 seconds:
When grabbed or picked up by the Killer, succeed a Skill Check to stab the Killer and escape from their grasp.
Stuns the Killer for 4 seconds.
Causes you to become the next Obsession.
Will to Live is deactivated once the Exit Gates are powered.
Will to Live is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after use.
Will to Live is deactivated prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action.

The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

alts.name: Resurgence
alts.desc:
After you are unhooked by any means, Resurgence triggers the following effect:
Grants you 50/60/70 % of Healing progression.

alts.name: Déjà Vu
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
The Auras of whichever 3 Generators are currently in closest proximity to one another are revealed to you.
Increases your Repair speed on those Generators by 4/5/6 %.

alts.name: Five Moves Ahead
alts.desc:
This perk activates while you are being chased by the Killer or are inside the Killer's Terror Radius:
After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50 % earlier.
See the auras of the 5 closest Pallets.
This perk goes on a 40/35/30 seconds cool-down when you drop a Pallet while this perk is activated.

builds.name: "Noob Helper" Build
notes: Focused on effects to help & guide a new player in your team.
Kindred, Aftercare or similar perks can help them keep an eye on you.
Corrective Action (or possibly Prove Thyself) makes it easier to do gens together and reduce missed skill-checks.

With Babysitter, you'll see the Killer's aura after unhooking and be able to determine if it's a good idea to heal quickly with We'll Make It. If the Killer returns, Babysitter provides great stealth and haste to the person unhooked.

perks.name: Aftercare
perks.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability:
You see the Auras of the 1/2/3  most recent Survivor(s) that helped you or vice versa:
Rescued from a Hook.
Completed a Healing action on.
They also see your Aura.
Aftercare resets its effects when you are hooked by the Killer.

alts.name: Kindred
alts.desc:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Whenever any Survivor is hooked, Kindred activates and applies the following effects:
The Aura of the Killer is revealed to all Survivors whenever the Killer comes within 14/15/16 metres of the Hook.
If you are the Hooked Survivor, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to each other.
If you are not the Hooked Survivor, the Auras of all other Survivors are only revealed to you.

perks.name: Corrective Action
perks.desc:
You start the Trial with 1/2/3 Token(s) and succeeding a Great Skill Check grants +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens.
While any other Survivor performs a skilful interaction that can trigger Skill Checks, they benefit from the following effects:
Converts any Failed Skill Check into a Good Skill Check.
This consumes -1 Token.
The Aura of that Survivor is revealed to you for 6 seconds.
Corrective Action does not apply to special Skill Checks.

alts.name: Prove Thyself
alts.desc:
Increases the Repair speed by a stack-able 6/8/10 % per other Survivor within 4 metres of your location, up to a maximum of 18/24/30 %.
Prove Thyself extends its effect to all Survivors within its range.
Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Prove Thyself at a time.

perks.name: Babysitter
perks.desc:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you benefit from the following effect:
The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
The unhooked Survivor benefits from the following effects instead for 20/25/30 seconds:
Suppresses the creation of their Scratch Marks and Pools of Blood.
Increases the strength of their Haste Status Effect by +10 %.

perks.name: We'll Make It
perks.desc:
After unhooking another Survivor, We'll Make It activates for 70/80/90 seconds:
Increases your Altruistic Healing speed by +100 %.

alts.name: Botany Knowledge
alts.desc:
You benefit from the following permanent effect:
Increases your Healing speed by 30/40/50 %.
